# v1.8.0 — Real-time sync across web and mobile

## Real-time refresh

- Added authenticated WebSocket `/api/ws?token=JWT` broadcasts for changes to projects, boards/tasks/checklists/columns, Nabava, and files. Events contain no record data; clients re-fetch through the existing REST API and authorization rules.
- Added nginx WebSocket upgrade headers and a one-hour read timeout.
- Added the mobile per-server `SyncBus` with scoped subscriptions for project, board, Nabava, and file screens; screens refresh silently after relevant events.
- Added reconnect backoff and a 20-second slow-poll fallback while sockets are unavailable.

## Nabava features included in this published tag range

- Added board To-Do lists and the global Nabava aggregation, with project/board origin links, synced completion/deletion, and configurable list naming.
- Added the mobile Nabava tab and per-board To-Do panel, including the admin list-name setting.
- These features were recorded as v1.7.0 work but have no separate published GitHub release; they are included here with the next published release.

## Verification

- Verified WebSocket events after REST mutations and handshake through nginx; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis and all 6 tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.8.0+5**.
